lines.zh: 我在海草床上爬，钳先探路。
lines.en: I crawl the seagrass bed, claws scouting ahead.

lines.zh: 水底的沙软，腿陷进去半分。
lines.en: The bottom sand is soft; my legs sink a little.
I shift along the shadow at the reef's base.

lines.zh: 尾扇一弹，我就退了一截。
lines.en: A flick of my tail fan backs me up.
Seagrass brushes my shell and tickles.
Beneath deep coral the way is darker.

lines.zh: 八条腿落地，一步也不打滑。
lines.en: Eight legs find the floor; not one slips.
A crab is ahead; I go around it.
I test the way ahead with long antennae.

lines.zh: 红草甸的泥粘在我的脚上。
lines.en: Red meadow mud clings to my legs.
The water presses my shell; I still walk.

lines.zh: 我顺着礁石往上爬一点。
lines.en: I climb a little way up the reef.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着半只贝壳，我跨过去。
lines.en: Half a shell lies buried; I step over it.

lines.zh: 腿多了也有好处，站得稳。
lines.en: Many legs have one benefit: I stand firm.

lines.zh: 我停在石缝口，钳收在胸前。
lines.en: I stop at the crack, claws folded to my chest.
The seagrass sways; I do not.

lines.zh: 有东西在沙里动，我等着。
lines.en: Something moves in the sand; I wait.

lines.zh: 我把洞口清干净，一遍又一遍。
lines.en: I clear my burrow mouth, again and again.

lines.zh: 深水里没有光，我靠触须。
lines.en: No light in the deep; I rely on antennae.

lines.zh: 我的壳和礁石一个颜色。
lines.en: My shell is the color of the reef.

lines.zh: 一只海星爬过去，我没理它。
lines.en: A starfish crawled past; I ignored it.

lines.zh: 水流从鳃边过，我在歇着。
lines.en: Water passes my gills while I rest.
I raise a claw, then lower it.
Sand settles on my shell; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我在等夜里出来的东西。
lines.en: I wait for what comes out at night.

lines.zh: 这块石头底下，别的龙虾不许进。
lines.en: Under this stone, no other lobster is welcome.
Shell scraps pile up inside my burrow.

lines.zh: 一动不动，才听得见远处。
lines.en: Only by staying still can I hear far off.

lines.zh: 你踩在礁石上，我就在下面。
lines.en: You stand on the reef, and I am underneath.

lines.zh: 你的脚很大，别踩我的洞。
lines.en: Your feet are large; spare my burrow.

lines.zh: 我举起两只钳，你先别动。
lines.en: I raise both claws; do not move yet.
Have you come for lobster tails?
I know the smell of nets.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进水里，太慢了。
lines.en: Your hand enters the water too slowly.
I pull back, but not into the burrow.
Three points of shell still dares to face you.
You crouched so long the water went still.

lines.zh: 我在量你的指头有多粗。
lines.en: I am measuring how thick your fingers are.

lines.zh: 别用手电照我，我看不见了。
lines.en: Not the lamp; now I cannot see.

lines.zh: 你要抓我，就得先撬开石头。
lines.en: To take me, you must pry the stone first.
A white split runs across my shell.

lines.zh: 壳底朝天，我腿在空中乱蹬。
lines.en: Shell to the sky, my legs kick at nothing.
I cannot lift that claw anymore.
Three points of shell will not last many hits.

lines.zh: 半根触须掉了，断口还在颤。
lines.en: Half an antenna is off, and the stump quivers.
I drag my shell back into the crack.
Sand worked into the split and it stings.

lines.zh: 打我的那只，我认得它的影子。
lines.en: I know the shadow of the one that hit me.
My tail fan will not close.

lines.zh: 壳再裂一次，我就活不成。
lines.en: One more crack and I will not survive.
That is fish; let it fall.
I do not eat dry things.

lines.zh: 味道沉到底了，我找得到。
lines.en: The scent sank to the bottom; I can find it.
Crack the shell open and I will eat.
My claws can tear it, but I am lazy.
Leave it on the sand; do not hand it over.
I sniff, then pinch off a small piece.
This is far better than dead fish.
Are you going to watch me eat?
Fed, my temper improves.

lines.zh: 你踢翻了我，我夹住你鞋。
lines.en: You kicked me over; I clamp your boot.
My shell hit the reef with a dull knock.
Half my burrow was crushed.
Do not crowd me; the claws move on their own.
I retreat two steps, then hold.

lines.zh: 水流把我推得侧了过去。
lines.en: The current pushed me onto my side.
Your knee struck my back.
I raise a claw, a warning only.

lines.zh: 沙扬起来，我找不到洞口。
lines.en: Sand clouded up and I lost the burrow mouth.
One bump and I guard this spot harder.
Her claws are a little narrower than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在石下挖了个共同的洞。
lines.en: We dug a shared burrow under the stone.

lines.zh: 我把触须搭在她的背上。
lines.en: I lay my antennae along the ridge of her back.
She eats first; I keep watch.

lines.zh: 两只龙虾挤在一个缝里。
lines.en: Two lobsters crowd into one crack.
The water cooled and we pressed closer.
She taps her shell; I answer twice.
We crawl the seagrass bed side by side.
Two exits, so either of us can flee first.
She left, and I am still here.
Take me by the back, clear of the claws.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一弹，你就松手。
lines.en: My tail snaps and you let go.
A claw has your knuckle.

lines.zh: 你提着我，我的腿还在划。
lines.en: You lift me and my legs keep paddling.

lines.zh: 提得太久，我的鳃就黏住了。
lines.en: Hold me too long and my gills stick together.
Three points of shell will not crack in your grip.
I flick my tail and splash your face.
Are you putting me in a bucket?
The water in the bucket is too shallow.
Put me back on the reef and I will settle.
That crab is on the other side of the stone.

lines.zh: 有东西在洞里，我听见了。
lines.en: Something is in the burrow; I heard it.
It is smaller than me; worth a try.
I fix on the slow one.
A tail shows above the sand.
This shell is thin; my claw can open it.

lines.zh: 它低着头啃壳，完全没留意。
lines.en: It keeps gnawing the shell, completely unaware.
I approach from downcurrent.
The target must be close; I am not fast.
That starfish is too hard; forget it.
Two are huddled; I take the smaller.
It backs toward its burrow; I get there first.
Today I mean to eat my fill.

lines.zh: 两只钳都开着，就等它进。
lines.en: Both claws are open, waiting for it to enter.
I slide along the sand, claws silent.
It looks back; I stop instantly.
The weeds screen my shell.

lines.zh: 还差一掌宽，我的钳就到。
lines.en: One palm's width more and my claw arrives.
I wait for it to lower its head and dig.

lines.zh: 我的触须先碰到它的尾。
lines.en: My antenna touches its tail first.
There is only one way for it to flee.
I edge sideways and block the burrow.

lines.zh: 水流往它那边，味道盖住我。
lines.en: The current runs toward it, hiding my scent.
It is nervous; its shell trembles.
I am in no hurry; the claws stay raised.
It is a hand's width from the stone.
Every three steps, it pauses for a moment.

lines.zh: 它不动的那一瞬，我扑上去。
lines.en: In the instant it freezes, I lunge.

lines.zh: 我把钳子举高，等它先动。
lines.en: I raise a claw and wait for it to move first.
The claw closes and the shell cracks.
I clamp its leg and hold.
It struggles; I press it into the sand.
My other claw comes in to finish.
One strike is not enough, so I strike again.
It bit my antenna and I flinched.
A tail snap and I back off half a step.
Blood darkens the sand around us.
My claw tip is stuck in its shell seam.
It bolted; I chase two steps.
That pinch took everything I had.

lines.zh: 壳碎了，里面的肉还在动。
lines.en: The shell broke and the flesh still moves.

lines.zh: 有更大的东西在看我们。
lines.en: Something larger is watching us.
I drag the prize back to my burrow.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁底，我在沙上出生。
lines.en: On the coral floor I was born in sand.

lines.zh: 深水珊瑚礁更暗，我也住。
lines.en: Deep coral is darker, and I live there too.

lines.zh: 海草床的根间，是我的路。
lines.en: Between seagrass roots runs my path.

lines.zh: 红色草甸的水底，泥很软。
lines.en: The red meadow floor is soft with mud.

lines.zh: 这一带六处水域，都算我的家。
lines.en: Six waters in this region all count as home.

lines.zh: 我和另一只一起被冲来。
lines.en: I was washed in with one other.
If the crack is deep enough, I can stay.
My shell is still soft, so I hide.
The reef above shields me from the current.
I picked a burrow away from the light.
The sand is full of shell bits; good cover.
The first night I did not dare leave.
A crab is digging some way off.
I widen the burrow mouth little by little.

lines.zh: 礁石下面有个缝，我先钻进去。
lines.en: There is a gap under the reef. I go in first.

lines.zh: 壳上还带着别的海的沙。
lines.en: There is sand from another sea on my shell.
The water boils and my shell ticks.

lines.zh: 从礁上摔下，壳磕了一角。
lines.en: I fell off the reef and chipped my shell.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我的鳃黏住了。
lines.en: No water here; my gills stick together.

lines.zh: 石头被炸开，我埋在底下。
lines.en: The stone burst and I am buried under it.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在我背甲的接缝里。
lines.en: The arrowhead is wedged in my carapace seam.
That flash made my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 五天没吃东西，壳都轻了。
lines.en: Five days without food and my shell feels light.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅水，我整只麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the shallows and numbed me whole.
No sand below; I have nothing to grip.
